          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income.grossMonthly = null or application.housing = null then null else (sum(for v in [application.housing.principalInterest, application.housing.taxes, application.housing.insurance, application.housing.hoa, application.housing.mip] return if v = null then 0 else v) + (if application.debts = null then 0 else sum(for d in application.debts return if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0))) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.ltv != null then application.ltv else if application.purpose = "purchase" and application.collateral.purchasePrice != null and application.collateral.appraisedValue != null then application.loan.amount / min(application.collateral.purchasePrice, application.collateral.appraisedValue) * 100 else application.loan.amount / application.collateral.appraisedValue * 100</text>

        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>if application.dti != null then application.dti else if application.income != null and application.income.grossMonthly != null and application.income.grossMonthly > 0 and application.housing != null and application.housing.principalInterest != null then (application.housing.principalInterest + (if application.housing.taxes != null then application.housing.taxes else 0) + (if application.housing.insurance != null then application.housing.insurance else 0) + (if application.housing.hoa != null then application.housing.hoa else 0) + (if application.housing.mip != null then application.housing.mip else 0) + (if application.debts != null then sum(concatenate([0], for d in application.debts return if d.include != false and d.monthlyPayment != null then d.monthlyPayment else 0)) else 0)) / application.income.grossMonthly * 100 else null</text>
